data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Preserve fail-open behavior on llm-api-call.sh non-zero exit for main tier (light/standard). When the runner calls llm-api-call.sh for the light or standard tier, it must append '|| LLM_TEXT=""' to capture failure without aborting: LLM_TEXT=$(bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)" ...) || LLM_TEXT="". The downstream JSON parse must then produce the inconclusive fallback ({"scores":{"hygiene":"N/A",...},"findings":[],"summary":"Review inconclusive..."}) when LLM_TEXT is empty. For deep-tier specialist calls (stdout redirected to slot files), the existing fail-closed validation (slot file exists + valid JSON) is unchanged.
